notes: 机器人变聪明了，也更像真人。选「餐饮」行业后它自带这一行的常识（过敏原与清真、点菜推荐、订位、外送平台怎么处理、投诉怎么接），资料里没写的不再一句「查不到」就转给你；回复会像真人那样分成两三条短消息，发之前顾客看得到「正在输入…」。新增「AI 表现」页面，机器人说错话你不用再翻聊天记录，问题会自己浮上来。新增菜单文件：顾客说「给我看菜单」直接把 PDF 发过去。新增预约：机器人把日期时间人数问齐，生成一条待你确认的记录——有没有位始终你说了算，它绝不替你答应。新增「帮我整理一下」：随手写几行，AI 排成客服要用的资料，只整理不编。还有门店与菜单管理、把人工回答教给机器人、从网址导入、备用 AI 接口（主接口故障自动顶上）、忘记密码可自助找回。顾客说吃出问题（过敏、中毒、异物、送医）时系统不经过 AI 直接通知你，并请顾客先就医。修复：发表情或图片不再误转人工导致对话中断；问「你是不是 AI」不再误转人工，机器人也不会再谎称自己是真人；回复里的星号不再漏给顾客。从 1.0.x 升级一次到位。
notesEn: The bot got smarter, and more human. Choose the F&B industry and it already understands allergens and halal, recommending dishes, reservations, how delivery-platform orders work, and handling complaints — it no longer dumps every unanswered question on you. Replies arrive as two or three short messages like a real person sends, and customers see "typing…" first. New Bot Quality page: you no longer have to read every chat to spot the bot saying something wrong — problems surface on their own. New menu file: when a customer asks to see the menu, the bot sends your PDF straight over. New bookings: the bot collects date, time and party size and creates a request for you to confirm — whether there is a table is always your call, it never promises on your behalf. New "tidy this up": jot a few lines and the AI lays them out as proper business info, tidying only, never inventing. Also outlets and menu management, teaching the bot from your own replies, import-from-URL, a backup AI endpoint that takes over if the main one fails, and self-service password recovery. If a customer reports getting ill (allergy, poisoning, foreign object, hospital), you are alerted without the AI involved and they are advised to see a doctor. Fixes: an emoji or photo no longer ends the chat by handing it to a human; asking "are you an AI?" no longer triggers a handover, and the bot will never claim to be a real person; stray asterisks no longer leak into replies. Upgrading from 1.0.x gets you everything in one step.
